title: When the Border Wakes
author: Juniper Blackwood
blurb: Mara Coldharbour, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
